purpose: Run the already frozen and tested independent reporter promptly after the protected-union OrthoBench pilot terminates, without waiting for another interactive submission or changing the scientific experiment.
dependency_scope: Afterany records unsuccessful producer outcomes as well as successful ones and avoids a permanently unsatisfied afterok job. It does not authorize score admission after failure. The frozen reporter requires producer job 24363 uniquely COMPLETED 0:0 on 16 CPUs at bizon before admitting any claimed successful cell.
preflight: Confirm the same native job is still live or authoritatively terminal; never restart it because an observation timed out.
Require the fresh v27 output absent and no matching queued reporting job; submit exactly one dependent reporter.

Verify both 484-test receipts and the existing frozen pending-probe evidence. Authenticate every reporter-file fingerprint from that probe against the pinned reporter Git revision and recheck the native launch/execution-plan pins and unchanged v26 summary/table.

Use only the existing frozen reporter CLI and original scientific runtime, with separate descriptive GNU-time and scheduler logs. No HMM inference, graph replay, native export normalization or tree reuse is added by this reporting job.
score_admission: The tested reporter authenticates the immutable native launch, complete source/input/runtime inventories, the independently verified fresh-search equivalence gate and matched canonical OrthoBench control. A scored cell requires terminal successful producer accounting, SUCCESS producer status, no error or postflight error, actual fresh native HMM/profile and phylogeny evidence, complete 251378-gene/12-species ownership, valid native pairs/confidence/checkpoints, exact native output manifests, independently reproduced official/reference F1/precision/recall and unchanged precommitted gate. Valid negative results remain valid negative cells. Other 27 method records and the control are inherited unchanged.
failure_policy: Retain every attempt and separate reporter failures from scientific failures. Missing, failed or stale partial producer reports supply no scores. After an abrupt producer failure its last on-disk status may remain a running-stage string; reconcile actual scheduler accounting independently rather than treating that string as proof of liveness. Reporter success alone does not establish producer success, score admission, gate passage or goal completion. Any failed reporting attempt is preserved; diagnose and use a separately justified fresh namespace for a retry, not an overwrite or inference rerun.
postflight_before_committing_accuracy: Independently inspect both terminal scheduler outcomes and rehash all retained receipts. Crosscheck actual official/independent F1, precision and recall, native coverage and gate; reproduce all 28 TSV rows, NA/completeness flags and exact preservation of all 27 parent method records. Commit and push v27 only after this additional readback. Incomplete or unsuccessful outcomes remain explicitly unscored; do not call a generated summary a new validated benchmark merely because the reporter exited zero.
advance_rule_unchanged: Prespecify unchanged-setting corrected-QfO and Three Kingdoms runs only after an independently admitted OrthoBench F1 gain with neither precision nor recall decreasing by more than 0.005. If the gate fails, stop this branch without relaxing it. No default promotion or eight-endpoint claim follows from an OrthoBench pilot alone.
timing_scope: Dependent readback is reporting/validation overhead, not another inference measurement. Keep its one-CPU GNU-time/process-RSS records separate from the 16-CPU fresh pipeline and cached accuracy control. Shared-host timing confounding remains explicit and nonblocking.
